camera.name: 急速推近
camera.motion: 镜头从中景快速冲向主体，一两秒内落到特写，制造突然被抓住的感觉
camera.motion_en: fast dolly push from medium shot straight into a close-up of the subject within about one second

camera.name: 缓慢推近
camera.motion: 镜头匀速、缓慢地向主体靠近，画面逐渐收紧，情绪慢慢升起来
camera.motion_en: slow steady dolly in toward the subject, framing gradually tightens

camera.name: 拉远揭示
camera.motion: 从细节特写开始向后拉开，逐步露出主体所在的完整环境
camera.motion_en: starts on a tight detail and pulls back to reveal the full subject and its surroundings

camera.name: 希区柯克变焦
camera.motion: 镜头前推同时变焦拉远（或反之），主体大小不变、背景纵深剧烈变化，制造心里一震的感觉
camera.motion_en: dolly zoom: camera moves in while zooming out, subject size stays constant while the background perspective stretches

camera.name: 慢速环绕
camera.motion: 镜头围着静止的商品慢慢转半圈，展示正面到侧面的立体外形
camera.motion_en: slow half orbit around the stationary product, revealing its form from front to side

camera.name: 转台旋转
camera.motion: 机位不动，商品放在转台上匀速自转，干净地展示每一面
camera.motion_en: locked camera, the product rotates slowly on a turntable showing every side

camera.name: 四分之一弧线
camera.motion: 镜头沿小弧线绕主体移动约四分之一圈，换一个更有层次的观看角度
camera.motion_en: camera arcs about a quarter circle around the subject to a more dimensional angle

camera.name: 横向平移
camera.motion: 镜头与主体平行地横向滑过，像扫过一排陈列或一个场景
camera.motion_en: smooth lateral tracking move parallel to the subject, sliding past the scene

camera.name: 跟随拍摄
camera.motion: 镜头跟着移动中的人或手保持固定距离，一起往前走
camera.motion_en: camera follows the moving person or hand at a constant distance

camera.name: 甩镜转场
camera.motion: 镜头快速横甩带出动态模糊，落到下一个主体上，常用作前后对比的衔接
camera.motion_en: quick whip pan with motion blur, landing on the next subject

camera.name: 升镜揭示
camera.motion: 镜头从低处缓缓升高，视野变开阔，交代整个空间或成套效果
camera.motion_en: camera rises from low to high, the view opens up to show the whole space

camera.name: 降镜贴近
camera.motion: 镜头从高处下降并靠近桌面或主体，把注意力收到商品上
camera.motion_en: camera descends from above and settles close to the product on the surface

camera.name: 正俯拍
camera.motion: 镜头在正上方垂直向下拍，带一点缓慢平移，适合平铺、摆盘和桌面操作
camera.motion_en: overhead top-down view looking straight down with a gentle drift

camera.name: 手持实感
camera.motion: 手机手持拍摄的轻微晃动和呼吸感，像普通人随手记录
camera.motion_en: handheld phone footage with subtle natural shake and breathing movement

camera.name: 第一视角行走
camera.motion: 以人的眼睛高度往前走，画面随步伐轻微起伏，像自己走进场景
camera.motion_en: first-person point of view walking forward at eye level with gentle step bob

camera.name: 人物环身手持
camera.motion: 手持绕着出镜人物走小半圈，展示穿着或手持商品的上身效果
camera.motion_en: handheld move circling partway around a person to show the outfit or product on them

camera.name: 微距滑移
camera.motion: 极近距离缓慢滑过表面，看清质地、纹理、颗粒或做工
camera.motion_en: extreme macro close-up slowly gliding across the surface texture

camera.name: 英雄仰升
camera.motion: 低机位仰拍并缓缓上升，让商品显得挺拔有分量，适合定格亮相
camera.motion_en: low angle hero shot slowly rising, making the product look tall and important

camera.name: 推近定住
camera.motion: 镜头推到商品近景后完全停住，留出清楚的定格画面给字幕或购买信息
camera.motion_en: pushes in to a close shot of the product then comes to a complete stop and holds still

camera.name: 锁定跟拍
camera.motion: 镜头跟着主体移动并始终把它锁在画面同一位置，结尾随主体停下而稳稳定住
camera.motion_en: tracks the subject keeping it locked in the same frame position, ending in a steady hold as it stops

camera.name: 穿越俯冲
camera.motion: 像穿越机一样快速俯冲穿过空间，最后落到商品前，节奏感强
camera.motion_en: fast FPV drone-style dive flying through the space and arriving in front of the product

camera.name: 焦点转移
camera.motion: 机位基本不动，焦点从前景虚化处转到商品上（或反过来），引导视线
camera.motion_en: near-static camera, focus racks from the foreground to the product, guiding attention

looks.name: 清透日光
looks.image: 白天自然窗光，画面明亮干净，色彩通透，阴影柔和，白色偏中性

looks.name: 暖调生活感
looks.image: 午后暖黄色室内光，生活化的家居环境，色调偏暖，氛围放松亲切

looks.name: 影棚质感
looks.image: 影棚布光，纯色或渐变背景，主光清晰、轮廓光勾边，商品质感和边缘干净利落
looks.motion: controlled studio lighting with crisp rim light

looks.name: 夜景氛围
looks.image: 夜晚环境，街灯或室内点光源，暗部较多，暖色与彩色灯光点缀，有氛围感但主体清楚
looks.motion: moody night ambience with practical lights

looks.name: 高级灰调
looks.image: 低饱和灰调配色，光线柔和均匀，画面克制简洁，显得质感高级

looks.name: 森系自然
looks.image: 户外或靠窗的绿植环境，柔和散射光，色调偏绿偏清新，有自然材质点缀
looks.motion: soft diffused natural light with greenery

looks.name: 食欲暖光
looks.image: 偏暖的侧逆光，食物表面有光泽和热气，色彩饱满诱人，背景略虚
looks.motion: warm appetizing backlight with gentle steam glow

looks.name: 科技冷调
looks.image: 偏冷的蓝白色调，深色桌面或背景，带屏幕或细线光反射，干净利落有科技感
looks.motion: cool blue-white tech lighting with subtle reflections

looks.name: 手机直出
looks.image: 普通手机后置摄像头直出画面，现场自然光，不调色，略有噪点，构图随意
looks.motion: unedited smartphone footage, natural available light

looks.name: 前置自拍
looks.image: 手机前置摄像头自拍视角，手臂伸出的距离，轻微广角变形，室内普通光线
looks.motion: front-facing phone selfie footage at arm's length

looks.name: 搁置机位
looks.image: 手机靠在桌上或架子上固定拍摄，机位偏低略歪，画面不动，人物在画面里自然活动
looks.motion: phone propped on a surface, static slightly tilted framing

looks.name: 行车记录仪
looks.image: 行车记录仪广角画面，车内或车前视角，画质偏硬，角落有时间水印的感觉但不出现可读文字
looks.motion: wide-angle dashcam footage from inside the car

looks.name: 老DV录像
looks.image: 老式家用DV录像质感，色彩偏旧、分辨率低、有轻微噪点和偏色，怀旧感
looks.motion: vintage home camcorder footage, low resolution and faded color

looks.name: 店内监控
looks.image: 店铺天花板角落的监控俯视视角，广角、画质偏灰、机位固定
looks.motion: fixed high-angle store security camera footage

subtle.name: 轻
subtle.motion_en: gentle, minimal camera movement, slow pace

normal.name: 中
normal.motion_en: moderate, smooth camera movement at a natural pace

strong.name: 强
strong.motion_en: bold, energetic camera movement with a fast pace

realism.zh: 有人出镜时写成真实的普通素人：自然皮肤纹理，能看到毛孔和细小瑕疵，不磨皮、不美颜，不是网红脸，也不刻意丑化，日常妆发和穿着，手机自然光下的真实质感
realism.en: ordinary real person, natural skin texture with visible pores, no skin smoothing or beauty filter, not an influencer face, not deliberately unattractive, everyday hair and clothing, natural phone-camera lighting

zh: 商品外形、logo、文字不变形，商品不凭空出现或消失
画面里不出现任何文字、字幕、标志和水印，商品上原有的字样保持原样不增不改（要加的字由 AE 后期叠加）
en: one continuous shot with no cuts
no human voice, ambient sound only
product shape, logo and text stay unchanged; the product never appears or disappears out of nowhere
no on-screen text, captions, logos or watermarks; any lettering already on the product stays exactly as is, nothing added (titles are added later in post)
